translations.web: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
translations.bsb: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
translations.kjv: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.
